mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.DESCRIPTION AS description, P.PRICE AS price, PI.IMG_URL AS thumbImgUrl FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMG PI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT F.FAQ_ID AS faqId, F.QUESTION AS question, F.ANSWER AS answer, F.CATEGORY AS category FROM FAQ F WHERE F.QUESTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR F.ANSWER LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY F.FAQ_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FAQ F WHERE F.QUESTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR F.ANSWER LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT E.EVENT_ID AS eventId, E.TITLE AS title, E.CONTENT AS content, DATE_FORMAT(E.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startAt, DATE_FORMAT(E.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endAt, EI.IMG_URL AS thumbImgUrl FROM EVENT E LEFT JOIN EVENT_IMG EI ON E.EVENT_ID = EI.EVENT_ID AND EI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE E.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR E.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY E.EVENT_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT E WHERE E.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR E.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT C.CAMP_ID AS campId, C.CAMP_NAME AS campName, C.ADDRESS AS address, C.DESCRIPTION AS description, C.INDUTY AS induty, CI.IMG_URL AS thumbImgUrl FROM CAMP C LEFT JOIN CAMP_IMG CI ON C.CAMP_ID = CI.CAMP_ID WHERE C.CAMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.ADDRESS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.INDUTY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY C.CAMP_ID, C.CAMP_NAME, C.ADDRESS, C.DESCRIPTION, C.INDUTY, CI.IMG_URL ORDER BY C.CAMP_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CAMP C WHERE C.CAMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.ADDRESS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR C.INDUTY LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
